map.怎么算“每层用时”？: How is the time per floor calculated?
map.急救包物品清单（按场景生成）: First aid kit item list (generated by scenario)
map.时间外还要核对疏散路线畅通、指引标识清晰、特殊人群（行动不便）有人协助，以及集合: Beyond the timing, also verify that evacuation routes are clear, signage is legible, people with limited mobility are assisted, and the roll call at the assembly point is complete.
map.演练评估只看时间吗？: Does drill evaluation only look at time?
map.若逐层记录到达集结点时间，用相邻层到达时间差除以该层人数；无逐层数据则用总人数/: If arrival times at the assembly point are recorded per floor, divide the difference in arrival time between adjacent floors by the number of people on that floor; without per-floor data, approximate the overall flow with total headcount / total duration.
map.记录演练疏散人数、楼层数与起止时间，算出总时长、人员流量与每层用时。: Record the number of people evacuated, the number of floors and the start and end times, then compute the total duration, the flow of people and the time per floor.
map.输入疏散人数、楼层数与起止时间，自动计算疏散总时长、疏散流量与每层用时，并按楼层: Enter the number of people evacuated, the number of floors and the start and end times to automatically compute the total evacuation duration, the flow and the time per floor, and assess drill efficiency against a per-floor benchmark
map.：5 层办公楼 600 人，9:00 开始、9:07:30 结束（450 秒），: : a 5-storey office building with 600 people starts at 9:00 and ends at 9:07:30 (450 seconds), so the flow is 600 / 7.5 = 80 people per minute. Floor 2 took the longest, with 150 people in 180 seconds (0.83 people per second), while other floors managed about 1.2 people per second, so the floor 2 exit should be upgraded first.
map.：疏散总时长 = 结束 − 开始；流量 = 疏散人数 ÷ 总时长；每层平均用时: : total evacuation duration = end - start; flow = people evacuated / total duration; average time per floor = people on that floor / (people on that floor / floor duration); the pass criterion is that the total duration is within the plan target and nobody is left behind.
